notes.title: The Adventure begins.
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Everyone here at JimJams Games is pleased to annouce that the Amazing Adventures of Lady Fanny Featherstone is now live and available to buy.

The Amazing Adventures is our take on the classic platformers / puzzlers of the past, and is yet another of our retro inspired games.

Join the good lady as she jumps, puzzles and explores her way through the mysteries of the island, apparently trapped in time.

Classicly inspired fun from..

The JimJams Games team.

notes.title: Join the Amazing Adventure.
notes.notes:
Hi All,

Watch this space for more information and revelations.

The JimJams Games team.
